'''José María Hernández''' (18 December 1959 – 15 February 2015) was a Spanish politician of the [[People's Party (Spain)|People's Party]]. He served as President of the Provincial Deputation of [[Province of Palencia|Palencia]]  from June 2011 until his death.

==Career==
Hernández was born 18 December 1959 in [[Ciudad Rodrigo]]. He studied biological sciences at the [[University of Oviedo]] and later basic education (EGB) at the [[University of Salamanca]].<ref name="tribuna">{{cite web |author= |date=15 February 2015 |title=Fallece José María Hernández, un político entregado a la provincia de Palencia |url=http://www.tribunaavila.com/noticias/fallece-jose-maria-hernandez-un-politico-entregado-a-la-provincia-de-palencia/1424013097 |url-status=unfit |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150217061409/http://www.tribunaavila.com/noticias/fallece-jose-maria-hernandez-un-politico-entregado-a-la-provincia-de-palencia/1424013097 |archive-date=17 February 2015 |accessdate=17 February 2015 |publisher=Tribuna Avila |language=Spanish}}</ref>

In 2003 Hernández was named territorial delegate of [[Castile and León|Castilla y León]] in [[Province of Palencia|Palencia]]. He became President of the Provincial Deputation of Palencia in June 2011 and served until his death for the [[People's Party (Spain)|People's Party]]. Hernández had also been member of the municipal council of the city of [[Palencia]].<ref name=elmundo>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2015/02/15/54e0c02d22601d307f8b4573.html |title=Muere a los 55 años el presidente de la Diputación de Palencia |language=Spanish |publisher=El Mundo |date=16 February 2015 |accessdate=17 February 2015}}</ref>

Hernández died on 15 February 2015 in the Clinical Hospital of [[Valladolid]] from a bacterial infection.<ref name=tribuna/> His remembrance service was held at the [[Palencia Cathedral]], under auspicies of Archbishop [[Esteban Escudero]]. Hernández was married.<ref name=elmundo/>
